record.body:
## Problem

The dashboard is only useful when it is one keystroke away in the tmux session.

## Approach

Not yet scoped. Direction: a tmux popup binding that opens `watch` in the current pane's repo, an optional persistent side pane, and a one-line Claude Code status line summary. Decide at plan-phase.

## Exit criteria

Not yet scoped. Decide at plan-phase.
